title: Review reads the leftovers, close-out writes the notes (3/3), and the post-deploy demonstration
description:
## As asked

Piece 3 of 3 of LIN-4347. Repository: JKershaw/LinearViewer (Harbour). Lands last, after piece 2 (the leftover mechanism) and the simple-dispatcher area notes. Its close-out closes LIN-4316 and runs the post-deploy demonstration that is LIN-4347's Done-when.

**What this piece delivers.** Review supplies the one read of what the change left at its edges, close-out writes what review routes to notes before merging, and the whole loop is demonstrated live.

**Approach (from the approved plan):**

* **Review** (`lib/prompt-template-defs.js`): one addition to the existing "Isolated, or One of a Class?" check: compare the `### Leftovers` answer with the diff and name every edge left that is neither tidied nor noted. Route each: in-area and fix-sized → a fix for close-out; larger in-area → a note entry close-out writes; outside the area → an outside follow-up. A leftover alone never makes review Request Changes (review-loop bound preserved); defects keep their existing route.
* **Close-out:** writes review's note entries into `docs/areas/<slug>.md` on the PR branch before merging, and remains the only follow-up filer. One sentence states the one-home rule: a filed follow-up will be done; a note is known but unscheduled; an in-area leftover is never filed. Keep LIN-4368's size record word for word through close-out's prune.
* Leave `retrospective-audit` and `retro` unchanged (removing or merging a step is John's ruling).
* **Docs and budgets:** `docs/architecture/prompt-system.md` (grounding line from piece 1, review's leftover read, close-out's note-writing). Raise review's and close-out's ceilings in `tests/unit/prompt-size-budget.test.js`, recording ticket and reason beside each raise.
* **LIN-4316:** close it with the reason that the Survey notebook's area knowledge now lives in maintained `docs/areas/` notes on main (piece 1).
* **Post-deploy demonstration (close-out runs it):**
  * The first ticket built under the autopilot after deploy shows, with nobody dispatching anything: a `leftover` dispatch with its own entry in `GET /issues/{id}/cost`, a `### Leftovers` comment, a PR carrying a tidy or a notes entry, and no `[leftover] skipped` log line for it.
  * The next ticket in a seeded area cites its note in its plan or PR (LIN-4349 and LIN-4350 are candidates). If that has not run by close-out, record what remains, why, and where the operator should verify it.

**Open ruling close-out must respect:** the 8 Nov `DECISION:` on LIN-4347 (comment `45d52e05-f3d8-48fa-8ff6-d783b2f6395e`) is unanswered. Until John answers, close-out must not count "That follow-on goes through the look-first step like any ticket" or "A follow-on that both readers judge better gets none of its own" as met.

**Testing strategy:** `generatePrompt` output for `review` contains the leftover-read routing and for `close-out` the one-home sentence; prompt-size budget test green with recorded raises; unaffected kinds' renders unchanged. The live demonstration above is the behavioural witness.

**Acceptance:** PR merged; LIN-4316 closed with reason; demonstration evidence (dispatch id, cost entry, `### Leftovers` comment, PR link) posted on LIN-4347, or the unrun part recorded for the operator.

**Starting point.** The parent LIN-4347's approved plan (revision 2, in its description under `## Implementation Plan`, read in full before starting) and the builder notes in its approving `### Plan Review Verdict` (comment `0ae2970d-05bf-48e7-aa4d-ca8ebd715312`) are this piece's starting point. Follow them; where the code shows them wrong, change course and say so on LIN-4347. The parent's `## As asked` block, its 7 Nov note and its `## Size of the move (the person's call)` comment hold the scope and John's rulings.

Session fit: fits one session
Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4347's approving plan-review (comment 0ae2970d-05bf-48e7-aa4d-ca8ebd715312, rev 2)
Grounding commits: `eeda7e44` (JKershaw/LinearViewer), `07c88f7` (simple-dispatcher). Re-check drift from these before building; LIN-4369 PR #2356 and LIN-4370 touch `lib/prompt-template-defs.js` and `tests/unit/prompt-size-budget.test.js` next, so rebase onto whichever lands first.

*End of what was asked. Steps write below this line; nothing above it changes.*

## Outcome

Implemented and merged in [PR #2359](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2359>) (`d5d18e6d`), deployed 8 Nov. It followed LIN-4347's approved plan (rev 2), with one recorded deviation: `LEFTOVERS_HEADING` moved to the leaf module `lib/dispatch-fields.js` to avoid an import cycle. Close-out made review's one fix (`495ffdd1`, the heading guard), closed LIN-4316, and filed LIN-4375 (wrong PR in the leftover prompt and wake). The post-deploy demonstration steps still to observe are recorded for the operator on LIN-4347. The full history is preserved in the task snapshots and the comment trail.

parent.title: After the merge: read it blind, ask the builder, tidy what it left

comments.body:
## Implementation: LIN-4374 (piece 3/3 of LIN-4347)

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2359 (head `3b3a0355`, branch `feat/lin-4374-review-leftover-read-close-out-notes`). CI is green on that exact commit, run 42446933997: Unit tests, E2E 1–4, secret scan, `CI success`.

**What changed**
- **Review** (`lib/prompt-template-defs.js`, one addition at the end of "Isolated, or One of a Class?"). Review reads the diff against the builder's `### Leftovers` comment, or the diff alone when there is none. It names every edge the change left that is neither tidied nor noted, and routes each one:
  - inside the area and fix-sized: a fix for close-out;
  - larger: a note entry close-out writes in `docs/areas/<slug>.md`;
  - outside the area: an outside follow-up.
  
  A leftover alone is never Request Changes, and a defect keeps its route.
- **Close-out** writes review's note entries on the PR branch before the merge (Make the Fixes, plus Workflow step 2) and stays the only filer. Follow-up Triage states the one-home rule in one sentence. The size-record prune line is unchanged, and a test pins it.
- `retrospective-audit` and `retro` are unchanged, and a test pins that too.
- **Docs**: `docs/architecture/prompt-system.md`, `docs/architecture/dispatch-and-proxy.md` and `docs/areas/README.md`. Piece 1 had already added the grounding line to `prompt-system.md`.
- **Budgets**: defs source +1123, review +515, close-out +268, `FROZEN_TOTAL_BYTES` 349803 → 351709. Each raise has its reason beside the ceiling, and the reasons they replaced moved to Ceiling history.

**Engineering choice:** `LEFTOVERS_HEADING` moved to `lib/dispatch-fields.js` and is re-exported from `lib/dispatch-leftover.js`. Review's template can then import the one spelling without an import cycle through `lib/prompt-templates.js`. A guard test fails on a retyped literal.

**Evidence**
- 36 of 40 renders (every kind plus an unknown kind, each with and without a `bug` label) are byte-identical to `main`. Only review and close-out changed.
- The new test file has 10 tests. Against `main`'s template, the 5 behaviour tests fail. The heading guard was mutation-checked and went red.
- `npm run test:unit`: 24294 / 24294 pass.

**Cuts:** none from this piece's `## As asked`. Building the PR does not finish this ticket's acceptance. These belong to close-out after the deploy, as the ticket says:
- close LIN-4316 with its reason;
- run the post-deploy demonstration (the `leftover` dispatch with its `/cost` entry, the `### Leftovers` comment, a PR with a tidy or a note, no `[leftover] skipped` line; then LIN-4349 or LIN-4350 citing a note);
- respect the unanswered 8 Nov `DECISION:` (comment `45d52e05`).

Next: `review` on PR #2359.

### Leftovers

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2359, head `e92c3a7fd34735bb686f4e6089e3f778b67277f4`. CI is green on that commit (run 42447808900).

- **tidied**: `docs/architecture/source-map.md` still listed `LEFTOVERS_HEADING` as `lib/dispatch-leftover.js`'s own constant. This PR moved it, so that line was untrue. It now says the module re-exports the heading and `lib/dispatch-fields.js` owns it.
- **noted** (`docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md`, under Waiting): where a leftover goes is now spelled in three places, with no test linking them: review's class check, `leftoverPrompt`, and the one-home section of `docs/areas/README.md` (close-out's triage sentence restates it).
- **noted** (`docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md`, under Lessons): `lib/prompt-template-defs.js` cannot import a module that imports `lib/prompt-templates.js`, because that makes a cycle. A spelling shared with such a module goes in a leaf module both import.
- **for close-out, a defect, not a leftover, outside this change's area (simple-dispatcher `hook.js` and Harbour's `prUrlOfFeedback` in `lib/dispatch-wake.js`)**: this leftover prompt named **PR #2357, not #2359**.
  - simple-dispatcher's terminal `[done]` entry sets `url` to `buildEvidence`'s `canonical` link. That is the tracked PR mentioned most often in the transcript: #2357 had 11 mentions here, from reading the parent's comments.
  - `prUrlOfFeedback` reads the newest entry's `url` first, so the session's own `DONE:` line (which names #2359) loses.
  - Any build that reads other PRs while it works can get the wrong PR in its leftover prompt, and in the parent's wake.
  - This matters for LIN-4347's post-deploy demonstration: check that the demonstration ticket's `leftover` prompt names the PR that build actually opened.

## Review — LIN-4374

Reviewed [PR #2359](https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2359) at head `e92c3a7fd34735bb686f4e6089e3f778b67277f4`. The PR is based on current `main` (`4ba6c817`, LIN-4373). It is MERGEABLE, and neither LIN-4369 nor LIN-4370 has landed, so no rebase is needed yet.

CI: green on `e92c3a7f` (Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, `CI success`; run 42447808900).

**Scope matches the plan.** The diff touches only review and close-out in `lib/prompt-template-defs.js`, the heading move (`lib/dispatch-fields.js`, `lib/dispatch-leftover.js`), the planned docs (`prompt-system.md`, `dispatch-and-proxy.md`, `docs/areas/README.md`), the leftover pass's `source-map.md` and `llm-and-prompts.md` entries, the budgets, the change log and one new test file. The plan had not named the heading move; it is recorded as a constraint and justified by the import cycle.

**Independent checks I ran**
- **Renders.** I rendered every template kind plus an unknown kind, with and without a `bug` label, on `main` and on the PR. 39 renders; only `review`, `review+bug`, `close-out` and `close-out+bug` differ, so `retrospective-audit` and `retro` are byte-identical.
- **Tests.** `node --test` on `lin-4374-review-leftover-read.test.js` and `prompt-size-budget.test.js`: 27/27 pass. The defs source is exactly 108717 bytes, at its ceiling.
- **Mutations** (each one reverted afterwards):
  - Remove review's leftover-read line → 3 review tests go red.
  - Remove the one-home sentence → the Follow-up Triage test goes red.
  - Remove close-out's note-writing sentence → the Make-the-Fixes test goes red.
  - Add a retyped `'### Leftovers'` literal in `lib/dispatch-leftover.js` → the guard test goes red.
  - **Inline `### Leftovers` in backticks inside review's template string, replacing the interpolation → everything stays green.** The guard only matches the single-quoted literal (`"'" + LEFTOVERS_HEADING + "'"`), so it misses exactly the retype a template would make. Fix 1 below.
- **Regression.** I read the last 8 commits on each touched file. The change is additive. The LIN-4368 prune line (`Keep the \`## Size of the move\` section verbatim`) is unchanged and pinned by a test. Nothing earlier is reverted or re-applied.
- **Class check.** Nothing else in `lib/` or `routes/` spells `### Leftovers`. `run-view.js` `'Leftovers'` and `leftoverPrompt`'s `# Leftovers:` title are different strings. The routing rule is spelled three times, and the builder already noted that duplication under Waiting in `llm-and-prompts.md`, so it is not untouched.

**Edges the change left** (a leftover read of the `### Leftovers` comment against the diff). The `source-map.md` tidy and both notes are on the branch. The only edge left untouched is the narrow guard above, which is in the area and fix-sized, so it goes to close-out as a fix.

**Open ruling.** I rechecked `rulings?issueIdentifier=LIN-4347&includeResolved=true`. The `lin4347-cuts` ruling (comment `45d52e05`) is still unanswered (disposition `resumable`). No new `DECISION:` is raised here.

### Fixes for close-out (before the merge)
1. `tests/unit/lin-4374-review-leftover-read.test.js`, test "no other file in lib/ or routes/ spells the heading": change `.includes("'" + LEFTOVERS_HEADING + "'")` to `.includes(LEFTOVERS_HEADING)`. The test should then fail on any spelling of the heading outside `lib/dispatch-fields.js`, whatever quoting is used; today no other file matches. Re-run the backtick mutation above and confirm it goes red.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Narrow heading guard** (inside: the one-spelling constraint is this change's own claim). Settled before the merge by fix 1. The check: a backtick-quoted `### Leftovers` written inline in `lib/prompt-template-defs.js` turns the guard red.
- **A deployed review really does the leftover read** (inside: review's leftover read, the first bullet of the approach). CI only proves the text renders. Settled after the deploy: the first review that runs after a build with a `### Leftovers` comment must have a summary that names each untouched edge with its route, or says there are none.
- **Close-out really writes review's note entries before merging** (inside: close-out's note-writing). Settled after the deploy: on the first close-out whose review named a note entry, the entry is in `docs/areas/<slug>.md` in a commit on the PR branch before the merge commit. If no review names one before this ticket's close-out, record it for the operator as not yet observed.
- **Post-deploy demonstration (a)** (inside: this ticket's Acceptance). Settled after the deploy. On the first ticket the autopilot builds after the deploy, with nobody dispatching anything, check for:
  - a `leftover` dispatch with its own entry in `GET /issues/{id}/cost`;
  - a `### Leftovers` comment;
  - a PR carrying a tidy or a notes entry;
  - no `[leftover] skipped` log line for it.
  
  **Precondition that tells right from wrong:** the `leftover` prompt and the parent's wake must name the PR that build actually opened, not another PR it read (see the outside item below). Post the dispatch id, the cost entry, the comment and the PR link on LIN-4347.
- **Post-deploy demonstration (b)** (inside: Acceptance). Settled after the deploy: the next ticket in a seeded area (LIN-4349 or LIN-4350) cites its area note in its plan or PR. If that ticket has not run by close-out, record on LIN-4347 what remains, why, and where the operator should verify it.
- **LIN-4316** (inside: Acceptance). Still in Backlog. Close it after the merge, with the reason that the Survey notebook's area knowledge now lives in maintained `docs/areas/` notes on main (piece 1, PR #2357).
- **Open ruling `45d52e05`** (inside: the parent's As asked). Unanswered. Close-out must not count "That follow-on goes through the look-first step like any ticket" or "A follow-on that both readers judge better gets none of its own" as met. Record them as awaiting John's ruling.
- **Wrong PR in the leftover prompt and wake** (outside: a defect in the canonical-evidence link and piece 2's PR extraction, not in the review/close-out prompts this piece changes). I confirmed it in code:
  - `simple-dispatcher/hook.js` `buildEvidence` sets `canonical` to `report.tracked[0]`, the tracked link mentioned most often.
  - `lib/dispatch-wake.js:279` `prUrlOfFeedback` checks each entry's `url` before its `message`, so the build's own `DONE:` PR loses to a PR it only read.

  Close-out files it after the existing-ticket check. The follow-up should say that the PR the session itself opened or reported (its `DONE:` line) should win over transcript mention frequency, for both the `[done]` canonical URL and `prUrlOfFeedback`. Demonstration (a) carries the live check meanwhile.

### Verdict
How the work meets each sentence of `## As asked`:
- **Piece 3 of 3, lands last, after pieces 1 and 2:** met. LIN-4371, LIN-4372 and LIN-4373 are Done and on main.
- **"Its close-out closes LIN-4316 and runs the post-deploy demonstration":** close-out's job, carried in the ledger.
- **What this piece delivers:** review's read and close-out's note-writing are met in the templates; the live loop demonstration is in the ledger.
- **Review approach:** met, in the class check. It compares the diff with `### Leftovers`, names edges neither tidied nor noted, routes them three ways, and says a leftover alone is never Request Changes while a defect keeps its route.
- **Close-out approach:**
  - note entries written on the PR branch before the merge: met;
  - stays the only filer: met;
  - one-home sentence: met, word for word in the rule's three clauses;
  - LIN-4368 size record unchanged through the prune: met and pinned.
- **retrospective-audit and retro unchanged:** met. Byte-identical, verified independently.
- **Docs and budgets:**
  - `prompt-system.md` has the piece-1 grounding line (line 18), the leftover read and the note-writing (line 30): met;
  - review and close-out ceilings are raised with ticket and reason, and the change log is updated: met.
- **LIN-4316 closure:** in the ledger (after the merge).
- **Post-deploy demonstration (a) and (b):** in the ledger (after the deploy, or recorded for the operator).
- **Open ruling:** respected. Still unanswered, and in the ledger.
- **Testing strategy:** met. The `generatePrompt` assertions for both kinds pass, the budget test is green with its raises recorded, and unaffected renders are unchanged. The one gap is the guard's narrowness (fix 1).
- **Acceptance:** PR merge, LIN-4316 and the demonstration evidence are close-out's work, all in the ledger.

No sentence is narrowed.

Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger

Autopilot note (verb override): after the Approve-conditional review (comment f69f770f) the engine recommended `implementation` for a one-line guard-test fix. The review itself lists that fix as close-out step 1 (before the merge), and close-out makes the fixes review asked for, so a separate fix round would only add a session and a re-review. Pinned `close-out`.

## Close-out — LIN-4374

**Merged:** [PR #2359](https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2359), squash-merged as `d5d18e6d0de2b220d66782a0d990d58649d98435`, pinned with `--match-head-commit` to `495ffdd1`. Main was still `4ba6c817` at merge time, so no rebase was needed; neither LIN-4369 nor LIN-4370 had landed.

**Deployed:** the harbour.cat footer has shown `d5d18e6d` since 05:16:55 UTC, 8 Nov. Rendering `review` and `close-out` at the deployed commit shows review's "What the change left at its edges" read, with its routing and the "never Request Changes" line. It also shows close-out's `docs/areas/` note-writing and the one-home sentence.

**How it meets what was asked:** as review's verdict (comment `f69f770f`) sets out. Every As-asked sentence is met or carried in the ledger, and none is narrowed.

**Final CI:** green on `495ffdd1` (run 42448772113: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, `CI success`).

### Changes made after the approval
- `495ffdd1`, which answers review's "Fixes for close-out" item 1: `tests/unit/lin-4374-review-leftover-read.test.js` now uses `.includes(LEFTOVERS_HEADING)` instead of the single-quoted literal.
  - Mutation check: inlining `` `### Leftovers` `` in review's template string turns the guard red (1 fail).
  - After reverting the mutation: 27/27 pass across this file and `prompt-size-budget.test.js`.

### Ledger
- **Narrow heading guard** (inside): **settled** by `495ffdd1` and the backtick mutation above, which was the exact precondition review named.
- **A deployed review does the leftover read** (inside, post-deploy check): **not run.** No build with a `### Leftovers` comment has gone to review since the deploy. The operator verifies it on the first such review. Recorded on the PR and on LIN-4347.
- **Close-out writes review's note entries before merging** (inside, post-deploy check): **not observed.** This ticket's review routed no note entry, because the builder had already written both notes. The operator verifies it on the first close-out whose review names one. Recorded on the PR and on LIN-4347.
- **Demonstration (a)** (inside, post-deploy check): **not run after the deploy.** No autopilot build had been dispatched when this session closed.
  - Pre-deploy partial witness, LIN-4374's own build on LIN-4373's code:
    - leftover dispatch `8aefde03`;
    - its own `kind: leftover` cost entry ($0.9932);
    - the `### Leftovers` comment `60c78ab6`;
    - PR #2359 with a tidy and two notes.
  - **Its distinguishing precondition failed:** the prompt named #2357, not #2359. That is the outside defect below.
  - The `[leftover] skipped` log was not checked (no log access).
  - The operator steps are on LIN-4347 (comment `c31b3dc1`) and the PR.
- **Demonstration (b)** (inside, post-deploy check): **not run.** LIN-4349 and LIN-4350 are both still in Backlog. What remains, why, and where to verify are recorded on LIN-4347.
- **LIN-4316** (inside): **settled.** Closed as Done with the reason (comment `7fd08439`): the Survey notebook's area knowledge now lives in maintained `docs/areas/` notes on main (LIN-4371, PR #2357), and `broad-options.md` is a pointer.
- **Open ruling `45d52e05`** (inside): **respected.** It is still unanswered (`lin4347-cuts`, disposition `resumable`). The two follow-on sentences are recorded on LIN-4347 as awaiting John's ruling, not met. No new `DECISION:` was raised.
- **Wrong PR in the leftover prompt and wake** (outside): **filed as [LIN-4375](https://linear.app/issue/LIN-4375)**, High (`priorityLevel` 3), labels `Bug`, `kind:follow-up` and `front:dispatcher-substrate`, related to LIN-4374.
  - Existing-ticket check: searched relations and `/search` for `prUrlOfFeedback`, `buildEvidence canonical` and `wrong PR`; nothing covered it. LIN-4005 has a similar symptom, but in the brief, not these files.
  - The leftover run's `[done]` entry carries the same wrong url (#2357), which confirms the defect again.

### Related tickets
- LIN-4316 → Done (above).
- LIN-4347 stays In Progress: demonstrations (a) and (b) are unobserved live, and ruling `45d52e05` is open.
- LIN-4371, LIN-4372 and LIN-4373 were already Done.

### Description
Archived first: snapshot `0a9f2ec7` (05:19:01) matches the pre-edit description exactly. There was nothing to prune: no step had written below the `## As asked` block, because the plan lives on LIN-4347, and the block (with its session-fit and plan-review lines) is untouched. A short `## Outcome` stub was added below the block.

issue.title: Leftover prompt and parent wake name a PR the build only read, not the one it opened
Area notes (1/3, simple-dispatcher): same docs/areas/ registry, README and guard test
Leftover step (2/3): builder asked what its change left behind at [done], wake held until it ends
